expects.rule: Selected work is visible on the first screen, as a grid or index with client, title and year or category, and each project opens on its own page.
Largest Contentful Paint is 2.5 seconds or less at the 75th percentile; image-heavy studio sites are the ones most likely to miss it.
Text keeps a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text), including white text over photographs and video.
Heavy motion has an off switch: users who prefer reduced motion get the animation disabled unless it is essential (WCAG 2.3.3, level AAA).
The studio says in one line what it does and for whom, and shows how to start a project (email or short form) on every page.
Team or about page names the people and the location; a studio with no named person reads as anonymous.
A way to skip the repeated header (a skip link, landmarks or headings) and keyboard access to the menu, as several listed sites provide.

traits: 7 of 8 use one or two typefaces (3 of 8 only one: Boc.Studio, Studio OL, Arrova); AUGE Experience uses three.
6 of 8 put work on the first screen: a project grid (AUGE, Boc.Studio, Core-A), one large photograph (Établissements, Scullion, IWONDERU).
5 of 8 set the studio name as oversized type (AUGE, Studio OL, Scullion, Arrova, IWONDERU's blackletter W).
4 of 8 open with an intro, counter or colour screen before the content (AUGE, Boc.Studio, Arrova, and Studio OL's blur-in).
5 of 8 sit on an off-white or light grey (#edeee5, #f7f4ef, #f2ecdf, #f1f1f1, #fff); 2 of 8 are near-black (Boc.Studio, Core-A); Scullion uses a saturated blue panel. None uses a gradient or cards.
Navigation is two or three links on 5 of 8 (Info, Projects, Work, About, Contact); Core-A has six and Scullion hides its links behind Menu.
4 of 8 show a city, coordinates, a clock or an address in text (Boc.Studio, Core-A, Studio OL, Arrova).
Project captions give client, title and a category or year (AUGE, Établissements, Core-A, IWONDERU).

sites.name: AUGE Experience
sites.why: Opens on black with a huge white condensed AUGE and an italic serif 'Experience' above a 0-100 counter, then an off-white (#edeee5) page with a grid of about 20 project covers labelled with client and a type (Website, Installation). Three faces: Neue Montreal, Greed, Farnham Display.
sites.recognition: Awwwards Site of the Day and Developer Award, 2026-11-12 (7.33/10)

sites.name: Établissements
sites.why: Off-white (#f7f4ef) page with a handwritten-script logo centred, Info at left and Projects at right in small caps, one portrait photograph of wrapped packages in the middle, and a caption with the client and its disciplines. Caslon italic with Sweet Sans. Under 15 words in total.

sites.name: Boc.Studio
sites.why: Opens on a full orange screen with the black logo, then a dark (#181d21) page: a repeating line 'Creative brand studio, Create, refresh and boost' with Barcelona coordinates, then a Work list with an All filter. One typeface, PP Mori; the page runs about three screens.

sites.name: Core-A Studios
sites.why: Near-black (#161515) screen: logo and a rotating menu (VFX, Updates, Work, Team, Directors) at left, a wide video project with a large bold title running off the edge, list and grid toggles, an Info button, a Kr/En switch and a local clock. Lausanne with Record Disc; about 45 screens long.

sites.name: IWONDERU Studios
sites.why: Light grey (#f1f1f1) page: a huge blackletter W logo top-left, a band with name, 'Est. 2016', 'Retouch & Post-Production' and Work, About, Contact, then a half-width close photograph of eye make-up with a brand caption. Portrait serif with Die Grotesk.

sites.name: Studio OL
sites.why: Beige (#f2ecdf) page with STUDIO OL in a huge serif across the full width, a blurred image behind a three-line centred bio, and a signature; About and Contact links. One typeface, Adobe Caslon. Screenshot caught mid-transition, so the work is not yet visible.

sites.name: Scullion Architects
sites.why: Split screen: a courtyard photograph with the large white letters SCUL across it, and a saturated blue panel holding a second, smaller photograph. Only a yellow MENU link shows; Projects, News, About and contact details sit in the menu. Founders Grotesk with Victor Serif.

sites.name: Arrova
sites.why: Opens on a white screen with a giant black bold '_a' cut off at the bottom right; the page text lists both office addresses, phone and email, then names such as Memorandum and Atelier. One typeface, Neue Haas Display. First screen caught mid-intro, so the featured project is not shown.

avoid: A reel or WebGL scene that hides the work and the way to contact the studio for several seconds.
Gradient hero with a claim such as 'We build digital experiences that drive growth' and no project visible.
Client logo walls with no case studies behind them.
Three-column feature cards with icons describing 'Strategy, Design, Development'.
Scroll-jacked horizontal sections and custom cursors with no reduced-motion fallback.
Project pages with only a hero image and a paragraph of generic process text.
Contact reduced to a form with no visible email address or location.
